LanguageData.VTE.BreakdownBankDesc: Friendly Lending Company charges its current handling fee on every transfer.
LanguageData.VTE.BreakdownStockMarketDesc: Buying caravan shares, business stakes, and public bonds is risky. Follow the wasteland news wire before committing your funds.
LanguageData.VTE.LoanExplanation: Friendly Lending Company loans can only be repaid from an account balance. Keep enough funds in the account when payment comes due, or repay early. An unpaid balance can cost goodwill with the sponsoring faction and bring Friendly Lending collectors until the account is settled.
LanguageData.VTE.IndebtedMessage: Relations with {FACTION_name} became hostile after Friendly Lending Company declared your account delinquent.
LanguageData.VTE.CollectorsText:
A Friendly Lending Company collection crew has arrived nearby.
They were hired on behalf of {FACTION_name} to collect your overdue debt.
LanguageData.VTE.CollectorsTextPartTwo: Pay the debt through a trading terminal to stop Friendly Lending Company from sending another crew.
LanguageData.VTE.SharesTransactionHeader: Positive numbers buy. Negative numbers sell.
LanguageData.VTE.BankDepositsToSpend: Select lender accounts to pay for securities
LanguageData.VTE.BankDepositsToGain: Select lender accounts to receive sale proceeds
LanguageData.VTE.ContractFullfilledDesc: A contract has been fulfilled by an interested party. The required funds have been transferred to them. A secured delivery is arriving with:
